brand.sub: WALMART ENDCAP · CONCEPT FOR TOEI ANIMATION × HYPERGALACTIC
brand.splashSub: Play it on Roblox now. See it in theaters in 2027. One Walmart endcap sells both.

product.label: Monkey Quest Cap
product.description: Black six-panel cap with the Monkey Quest mark embroidered on the front and a red under-brim. A woven NFC label sits under the brim.

product.label: Mini-Might Plush
product.description: The Mini-Might, Okon's tiny clone and the collectible pet of the Roblox game, as a 30 cm plush with an NFC chip in the tush tag. One tap and its digital twin joins you in Hypergalactic: Monkey Quest, and the film's first-look clip unlocks.

unlock.title: Mini-Might pet + film first look
unlock.sub: Pet in Monkey Quest on Roblox · clip from the 2027 film

product.trigger: NFC chip in the tush tag

product.label: Mini-Might Keychain
product.description: An acrylic Mini-Might charm with an NFC tag and a QR on the back. The lowest-price way into the game, clipped to a backpack every day.

unlock.title: Mini-Might sled skin
unlock.sub: For the sled runs in Monkey Quest

product.trigger: NFC tag + QR on the charm back

product.label: Sled Run Desk Mat
product.description: XL desk mat printed with the sled-run key art, rolled in a branded sleeve. The QR is part of the artwork, so the print itself is the trigger.

product.label: Movie Collector Box
product.description: A window-box collectible built for the 2027 theatrical release. The QR inside the lid unlocks a behind-the-scenes clip and a ticket-on-sale alert, and grants a film-exclusive item in the game.

product.label: Monkey Quest Tee
product.description: Heavyweight black tee with the Hypergalactic Monkey Quest mark and an NFC care label. Wear it, tap it, and the same tee lands on your avatar.

product.label: Monkey Quest Hoodie
product.description: Okon-red pullover hoodie with the Monkey Quest mark. Owning it unlocks the matching layered hoodie for your avatar, ready for opening weekend.

tour.title: Stop them in the aisle
tour.body: A 3.84 m Walmart endcap for Monkey Quest: two lightbox towers, a lit header, a 12-tile video wall and a hero screen. One fixture carries the Roblox game today and the Toei Animation film in 2027.

tour.title: The game is live now
tour.body: Hypergalactic: Monkey Quest, built by Twin Atlas for Toei Animation, is the hub of the Monkey Quest universe on Roblox. Players sled, battle Xenons and collect Mini-Might pets. The display sells that world at shelf height.

tour.title: The Mini-Might is the hero SKU
tour.body: Okon's tiny clones are the most collectible thing in the game, so they lead the shelf: a plush, a keychain, apparel and a desk mat. Every product carries NFC, and every tap puts its digital twin in the game.

tour.title: Tap, play, unlock
tour.body: The QR on the right tower is real: scan it and Hypergalactic: Monkey Quest opens on Roblox. The activation flow turns a Walmart purchase into an in-game Mini-Might and a first look at the film.

tour.title: Flip to the film campaign
tour.body: The same hardware re-skins for Toei Animation's 2027 theatrical release: film key art on the towers and hero screen, a movie collector box on the shelf, and the game promoted on the totem. Players become the opening-weekend audience.

tour.title: Measured, and built modular
tour.body: Activations, returns to the game, film first-look views and sell-through are reported by store and SKU. Six modules bolt together on site, so each campaign phase swaps graphics, not fixtures.
